source_evidence: src/alphanet.h now models eight complete 0x19C player records beginning at 0x76C, ending at ledger 0x144C; src/net_class.h removes the unsupported Net tail pad and AlphaNet owns count 0x768. Original callback/constructor/close evidence is retained beside the declarations. src/alphanet.cpp uses the real fields in all four lookups and close, and src/netdaemon.cpp indexes the same record for message status. Heap and ledger are independent ordinary members, with destruction owned by AlphaNet and Net rather than repeated in NetDaemon. recovery/tests/test_application_link_recovery.py checks emitted layouts, preserved primary-table targets and destructor references; recovery/tests/alphanet_records_harness.cpp exercises the live lookup/reset bodies and record/member lifecycle with instrumented collaborators. This incorporates the record-boundary interpretation, not final lifecycle or game acceptance; alphanet-ledger-lifetime remains open.
